name: Axiom Defense Solutions Thermal Stealth Cloak
description:
This is not clothing. It is a wearable system. The Axiom ThermoCloak is a full-length hooded garment constructed from a phase-change metamaterial that actively disrupts thermal signature — wearing it, you appear on infrared as background noise. The outer surface can be set to passive environmental matching (not true invisibility, but significant visual disruption at range in low light). Battery life is eight hours active. The fabric is stiff at the edges and moves like a very heavy coat. It weighs four kilograms.

Axiom Defense Solutions is a Corponation-tier manufacturer, and this item is technically export-controlled — civilian purchase requires a Tier 4 security clearance or a corporate sponsorship letter. In practice, maybe one in ten buyers has the paperwork. The rest acquired theirs through the grey market, which Axiom tolerates because it keeps prices high and demand mysterious. Operators, fixers, corp security, and occasionally very serious criminals wear these. You do not buy this coat because it looks good.
functionality: Active thermal signature suppression; passive visual disruption in low light; 8-hour battery life; requires charging via standard power port
what_it_says: You are a professional who needs to not be seen, and you have the resources to make that happen. Whatever you're doing, it is serious.
worn_by: grey-market buyers with money and need
story_hooks: One of these was found at a crime scene — the serial number has been physically removed, but Axiom embeds a secondary identifier in the power cell that most people don't know about
A batch of counterfeit ThermalCloaks has hit the grey market; they look identical but the thermal suppression fails randomly, which is worse than having nothing
Someone is selling these to the Gray Zone-based resistance groups at a massive discount — Axiom wants to know who and why, and is willing to pay for that information

physical_description.visual_profile: A full-length hooded cloak with an intentionally austere, almost architectural silhouette. The garment hangs like a heavy curtain, creating sharp geometric lines at the edges. The hood is deep and angular, designed to obscure facial features. On thermal imaging, the wearer appears as ambient environmental noise. Visually, the surface exhibits subtle chromatic drift and micro-distortion at range in low light—not invisible, but deliberately hard to track.
physical_description.fit: Deliberately oversized and voluminous to accommodate layered undersuit or tactical gear. The cut prioritizes concealment and functionality over form-fitting aesthetics. Shoulders are broad and reinforced. Fabric is stiff and maintains its shape rather than conforming to the body.
physical_description.primary_material: Phase-change metamaterial composite—a cutting-edge synth-polymer that actively shifts thermal signature in response to body heat and ambient temperature. Outer layer is a light-absorbing ballistic weave with embedded conductive threads.
physical_description.texture: Rigid and deliberately stiff, especially at seams and hem. The surface has a faint granular quality under close inspection—evidence of the metamaterial structure. Movement reveals a subtle mechanical rustling. Not designed for comfort; designed for function.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal-grey with undertones of deep navy. Completely desaturated—no reflective trim or accent colors. The surface appears to absorb light rather than reflect it. Occasional subtle iridescent distortion when the phase-change material cycles.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty magnetic snap system down the front, paired with a friction-fit shoulder harness. A small integrated control panel (roughly 3cm square, recessed into the left inner chest) houses the thermal management and battery indicator. No traditional buttons or zippers—all closures are designed for rapid donning/doffing and minimal failure points.
distinctive_features: Recessed control panel with haptic feedback buttons and LED status indicator
Integrated battery pack (8-hour capacity) housed in lower left seam pocket
Thermal sensor nodes embedded at shoulders, chest, and back
Reinforced edge-paneling at wrists and hem with micro-servo tension adjustment
Hidden equipment loops along inner seams
Axiom Defense Solutions logo (Φ-stamped insignia) on right shoulder—small, intentionally understated
No visible branding on outer surface; only a discrete QR-etched security tag near the hem
Stiff, deliberate wrinkles and fold-lines that suggest the material does not move naturally
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury, but inaccessible to most. Export-controlled corporate manufacturing. Street value on the grey market: 18,000-25,000 Φ. Ownership signals either deep corpo connections, criminal resources, or grey-market access.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate security operators, fixers, extraction specialists, intelligence contractors, and very serious criminals. Wearing one announces: I have access to restricted technology, I can afford military-grade equipment, and I am not interested in looking fashionable. A statement of operational capability rather than style. Wearing it casually signals either paranoia or a credible threat profile.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine on first acquisition, then rapidly weathered through use. Stains and scoring on the outer surface are badges of operational history. Older units develop micro-cracks in the metamaterial structure, visible as faint seam-lines. Battery charging ports accumulate oxidation. A well-worn ThermoCloak is evidence of survival.
